verdict.rationale: SumUp's own SDK runs non-interactively in server runtimes with API-key auth read from an environment variable. Sandbox merchant accounts, test cards and a Virtual Solo reader simulator let automated flows run without real hardware or money, so headless operation is directly documented. CI is not explicitly addressed. Missing for 10: explicit CI/pipeline documentation or guidance, and independent or hands-on corroboration of automated test runs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: The client reads the `SUMUP_API_KEY` environment variable automatically, so deploying with `SUMUP_API_KEY=sup_sk_MvxmLOl0...` is enough for most server workloads.
works in modern JavaScript runtimes and platforms, including Node.js 18+, Cloudflare Workers, Vercel, and other ESM-friendly environments
API keys are static credentials that let your application act on behalf of the merchant account that created the key.
SumUp provides sandbox merchant accounts and a comprehensive set of test cards to simulate various payment scenarios
Virtual Solo simulates a Solo card reader so you can test pairing and checkout flows.
